'''Bunker 1-Z7''' was one of several bunkers constructed and manned by the [[Order of Revan]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] around [[3637 BBY]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] the bunker was assaulted a strike team making their way to the large signal jammer located on the island.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bunker 1-Z7 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion during the "Battle of Rishi" flashpoint.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
